title: Learning Chaos Without Seeing Chaos: Extrapolation of Global Dynamics in Autoregressive Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.38814v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive models are trained to predict a system's behavior one step at a time, and recursive generation allows the learned dynamics to unfold over long horizons. To what extent can such dynamics learned from local observations recover broader organization of an underlying system that was only partially observed during training? Here we study small autoregressive transformers trained from scratch on trajectories sampled from restricted parameter regimes of several non-linear dynamical systems, including logistic and sine maps, the Lorenz system, and the generalized Hopf system, with control parameters and state trajectories represented as sequences of continuous tokens. Under closed-loop evaluation at parameters far outside the training distribution, the models can recover self-similar period-doubling cascades, chaotic dynamics, and attractor structures with remarkable visual and numerical fidelity. translated_title: 无需目睹混沌即可学习混沌：自回归Transformer对全局动力学的外推
translated_abstract: 自回归模型被训练用于逐步预测系统的行为，而递归生成使得学到的动力学能够在长时程上展开。这种从局部观测中学到的动力学，在多大程度上能够恢复训练期间仅被部分观测的底层系统的更广泛组织结构？本文研究了在多个非线性动力系统受限参数区域内采样得到的轨迹上从零开始训练的小型自回归Transformer，这些系统包括逻辑斯蒂映射和正弦映射、Lorenz系统以及广义Hopf系统，其中控制参数和状态轨迹被表示为连续token的序列。在训练分布之外的参数上进行闭环评估时，这些模型能够以显著的视觉和数值保真度恢复自相似的倍周期级联、混沌动力学以及吸引子结构。对于逻辑斯蒂映射，...
tldr: 自回归Transformer仅在受限参数区域的局部轨迹上训练，就能在远离训练分布的参数处外推并高保真地恢复非线性系统的全局动力学，包括倍周期级联、混沌和吸引子结构。
en_tdlr: Autoregressive transformers trained only on trajectories from restricted parameter regimes can extrapolate far beyond the training distribution and faithfully recover global dynamics of nonlinear systems, including period-doubling cascades, chaos, and attractor structures.
